description: An expander for Temporal Deck that draws the buffer as a scrolling waveform, and lets you drag that waveform to move the playhead
notes: it works only when placed immediately to the right of a Temporal Deck; on its own the screen stays dark and dragging it does nothing
drag the waveform up or down to move Temporal Deck's playhead, the same gesture as turning the platter; the amber band across the picture marks where the playhead is
there are no jacks and no knobs on this module: everything it shows comes from the Temporal Deck beside it, and everything you can set is on its right-click menu
menu: Mono — draws one waveform made from both channels
Stereo (side-by-side) — draws the left and right channels as two waveforms next to each other
Inverted Vertical — flips the picture top to bottom, so the newest sound is drawn at the other end
Scope Range: Auto (window peak), +/-2.5V full width, +/-5V full width, +/-10V full width — sets the voltage that fills the width of the display, or scales it to the loudest part on screen
Colors: Default (Purple/Cyan), Classic (Green/Red), Monochrome (Gray/White), Fire (Red/Yellow), Retro Amber, Retro Green — picks the colour scheme the waveform is drawn in
Brightness — a slider setting how bright the waveform is drawn
